scope: Recursive detail DFS and retained directory admission within existing platform/scanner crates
Borrow progress projection instead of copying hard-link ledgers; one shared progress clock and final cancellation gate
No new crate/dependency, public limit field, default-limit change or end-to-end speed claim

contracts.directories: Outer target and suspended ancestor capabilities count. Inspect child with admission before retained directory construction. Root allowance zero refuses before root admission; direct aggregates include target state.
contracts.traversal: Iterative DFS retains at most one bounded token batch per ancestor. No opened sibling queue or path reopen. Metadata retained across depth still needs global memory accounting.
contracts.mount: Combined mount/admission inspection preserves Linux/Windows native denial and macOS ordinary file/link mount observation. Files can still be observed at full directory capacity; transient native inspection descriptors are separate.
contracts.progress: Borrow accumulators; hard-link ledgers are not Clone. Periodic callbacks share 120ms policy across direct subtrees, only final provisional may flush sooner. Terminal result retains all rows; last callback cancellation refuses complete publication.
contracts.excluded: Per-call retained directory capabilities are not whole-process FD/Windows executive handle/RSS bounds. Linux active cursors retain separate stream FDs. Scanner data/transient opens, other discovery/fingerprint/legacy paths, and full global metadata retention remain open.
contracts.evidence: No-follow, native identity, mount, logical/unique accounting, unknown allocation, provisional lower bounds and incomplete refusal preserved. No deletion authority from progress.
contracts.postMatrixChanges: Only public rustdoc wording and aligned documents changed after final functional matrix.

fixture.oracle: Ordinary independent recursive read_dir/symlink_metadata totals and device/inode hard-link dedup, per-direct-row subtree walk. Snapshot descriptor names then ordinary fstat aliases, count only fixture directory objects; no production/private counters.
fixture.allocation: macOS accepted allocation stays UnknownIdentity despite nonzero ordinary stat. Linux independently checks blocks times literal 512 after native execution, still not run here.
fixture.progress: Independent callback-entry clock pins literal 120ms periodic contract, permits only last provisional earlier; functional test duration is not a performance sample.
